name: CVC
body: HSTS runs a full year, framing is limited, and unknown paths answer 404. But www.cvc.gov.co and cvc.gov.co both serve the site, each names itself canonical, and the sitemap lists only the bare host.
lesson: Pick one host, 301 the other to it, and keep canonicals and the sitemap there.
summary: www.cvc.gov.co scores 73 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 26 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: 4891 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 4891 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: cvc.gov.co (4891). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.cvc.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: cookiesession1. Without HttpOnly: cookiesession1. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /acerca-de-cvc, /directorio/directores and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 13 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 10 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /directorio/directores, /directorio/sedes-de-la-cvc, /Estatutos-Corporativos and 6 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 707 ms
